entities.name: Bunny
entities.description: The earliest defense mechanism of purity and hope who carries the original Wind Surge power.
entities.quote: He is not Robin. He is not Zaan. He is Bunny — the earliest defense mechanism of purity and hope.

entities.name: Robi
entities.description: A split soul born of war and refined by silence who shapes and controls blood as a refined discipline.
entities.quote: ROBI — THE GALE WARDEN (Split soul: born of war, refined by silence)

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: A nightmare scripted in code, blood, and void who wields forbidden Bloodbinding and Umbra Control.
entities.quote: Khalid is no longer just a villain — he’s a nightmare scripted in code, blood, and void.

entities.name: Zaan
entities.description: A living doctrine of immortality and rage who masters Bloodbinding beyond life or death.
entities.quote: He is not made of flesh. He is made of memory. And memory... refuses to die.
